explication: This repository is a curated public-API catalog, with the README as its primary product surface. A developer browses the catalog, selects an API or the APILayer unified access offering, follows provider documentation, and receives domain-specific JSON data. The sampled runtime layer is maintenance validation: format checks inspect README table structure, while link checks extract URLs, detect duplicates, and make HTTP requests. CI and tests are intentionally excluded; provider implementations are external and unsampled.
